caption: The six training tomatoes drawn in the (R, A) feature plane. The vertical rule at R = 147.5 puts every ripe sample on its right and every unripe sample on its left, while the two classes' area values share the band 39 to 42 pixels, so area alone would not separate them.

spec.aria: A scatter plot of red intensity R against area A in pixels with three ripe samples at high R and three unripe samples at low R, separated by a vertical line at R = 147.5, with the area values of both classes overlapping between 38 and 43 pixels.
